story.title: A pantry brand that starts from the home kitchen.
story.body: SAMARA from Home hadir sebagai brand kuliner rumahan dengan ragam saus dan bumbu praktis. Handle @samara.fromhome dapat dikorroborasi dari publikasi lama yang menyebut pendirinya sebagai pengusaha kuliner. Pada audit ini, URL marketplace yang sudah tersimpan di repo tidak muncul pada hasil pencarian independen, sehingga TradeLink mempertahankannya sebagai kanal brand-listed—bukan memberi label verified store.

stats.label: @samara.fromhome is independently corroborated by a published contributor biography
brand positioning centers on sauces, seasonings and practical cooking formats
direct social discovery remains the clearest public route in this OSINT pass
food-service fit is presented as a conversation opportunity, not a verified scale claim

highlights.title: Pesto & Herb Direction
highlights.body: Herb-led sauces provide a practical base for pasta, sandwiches, grilled protein and home cooking.

highlights.title: Chimichurri Direction
highlights.body: A bright herb-and-acid profile suited to grilled dishes, roasted vegetables and finishing applications.

highlights.title: Indonesian Pantry Direction
highlights.body: Local flavour references such as rawon can translate heritage taste into an easier cooking format.

highlights.title: Creamy Comfort Direction
highlights.body: Creamy and cheese-forward variants extend the pantry into pasta, dips and baked dishes.
